from tinygrad.device import Compiled


def facts():
    d = KD.KTPUDevice()
    return {
        "compiled": isinstance(d, Compiled),
        "allocator": type(d.allocator).__name__,
        "renderer": type(d.renderer).__name__,
        "runtime": d.runtime_t.__name__,
        "graph": d.graph.__name__,
        "rt": d.rt is DEV,
        "sync": d.synchronize() is None,
    }
